summary: Detect human-only blockers (credentials, trusted publisher, PyPI, marketplace, billing, external accounts) and optionally open Task issues with dedupe markers (#360); MCP plate_task_detect + gh plate task --detect/--apply.
migration_impact: New detect path defaults to classification-only. create/apply opens Tasks using #359 contract. Dedupe skips when an open Task already tracks the blocker class.
migration_guidance: 2. On CI/session signals that look human-only: plate_task_detect (dry) first.
3. When confirmed: plate_task_detect create=true dry_run=false or gh plate task --detect --signal '...' --apply.
4. Never invent PLATE-TASK-CLOSED; humans complete external work.
agent_notes: Complements #359 explicit create. Agent-solvable signals must not open Tasks. Closes #360.
